suppress_upstream.reason: CloudLinux 10 alt-python-internal-libs requires libnsl.so.3, and libnsl2-2.0.1-2.el10 ships in alt-common. Removing it makes alt-python-internal uninstallable, and under allow_erasing dnf then erases cloudlinux-venv, lve-utils, cagefs, alt-python27-cllib, lve-wrappers and lvemanager with it, silently.
lve-stats requires alt-ImageMagick, which requires libwmflite-0.2.so.7. libwmf-lite-0.2.13-6.el10_0 ships in EPEL 10, which is an enabled target repository.
Second dependency of alt-ImageMagick, and therefore of lve-stats. LibRaw-0.21.3-1.el10_0 ships in EPEL 10. Upstream both removes it and offers it as an upgrade in the same solve; the removal wins.

alt-cyrus-sasl-lib, alt-openldap11-servers and alt-php-internal-dba all require libdb-5.3.so, and libdb ships for el10 in alt-common. This one is not theoretical: alt-cyrus-sasl-lib was installed on a CL9 box and gone after an upgrade that otherwise looked clean.
alt-openldap11-servers requires it, and it ships for el10 in alt-common.
alt-php-internal-enchant requires it - the PHP enchant extension, so a live dependency on a hosting box. Ships for el10 in EPEL 10.
gearmand requires it, and it ships for el10 in AlmaLinux AppStream.

LibRaw-static and alt-ImageMagick-static-devel require it, and LibRaw-devel-0.21.3-1.el10_0 ships in EPEL 10 beside the LibRaw kept above. Removing it keeps the library but erases its headers, and under allow_erasing both dependents go with it, silently.
libdb-devel-static requires it, and libdb-devel-5.3.28-64.el10_0 ships in EPEL 10. libdb itself is kept above; removing only its headers would erase the static library with them, silently.
alt-ImageMagick-static-devel requires it, and libwmf-devel-0.2.13-6.el10_0 ships in EPEL 10 beside the libwmf-lite kept above. Removing it would erase that CloudLinux package with it, silently.
